title: Batching Guidance Oracle: continuous workload profiling and safe apply
creator: Priya Nair
description: Build a lightweight 'Batching Guidance Oracle' service that continuously profiles customer workloads and produces per-route batching and caching configuration suggestions with automated, safe rollouts. The Oracle outputs ranked configuration proposals (batch_size, max_latency_slo, kv_cache_ttl, coalescing_window, quantization_hint) along with confidence scores and a staged apply plan. The goal is to reliably reduce token cost and GPU occupancy while respecting latency SLOs and minimizing correctness regressions.
context: We currently have multiple batch recommendation and profiling efforts (autotune profiles, fingerprinters, continuous profilers) but lack a unified, conservative autopilot that (1) aggregates long/short-term workload signatures, (2) estimates economic impact, (3) simulates safety envelopes, and (4) performs incremental application with rollback hooks. This ticket centralizes that capability as a service consumed by Console and Dedicated control plane.
proposal: Implement a service with three components: (A) Profiler: streaming workload signatures (seq_len distribution, request interarrival, KV cache hit sim, model variant compatibility) and periodic heavy snapshots; (B) Heuristic Engine: rule-based + small ML ranker that proposes candidate configs and predicts latency/cost delta and quality risk; (C) Safe Apply Controller: staged rollout (shadow -> canary -> percent-based ramp -> full), automated rollback triggers (99th tail increase, error rate, eval quality delta), and audit logs. Integrate telemetry and an operator UI in Console for manual review/override.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Oracle produces proposals for 90% of instrumented HTTP routes in staging with confidence scores and expected cost delta.
2) Safe Apply Controller can execute a shadow trial and perform a canary (1% traffic) rollout in staging and then in production under policy.
3) Automated rollback triggers detect and revert a deliberately injected latency regression in a controlled test.
4) Console surfaces proposal rationale, expected savings, and a one-click apply/rollback flow.
5) Unit/integration tests for profiler heuristics + end-to-end integration test that verifies audit logs and metrics emitted.
technical_notes:
- Profiler stores lightweight time-series fingerprints (histograms) and maintains rolling windows to detect concept shift.
- Heuristics are prioritized: safety-first rules (no increase to batch if 95th latency within 5% headroom), cost-lookups using cost-per-token model, then ML ranker trained on historic AB trials.
- Simulate KV cache effects by modeling prefix reuse probability from recent requests; propose TTLs per-route.
- Safe Apply uses feature flags + routing rules in control plane; all changes are idempotent config updates with explicit rollback IDs.
- Keep data residency rules: telemetry anonymized; PII never sent to Oracle service for Private deployments.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (staging): Profiler + offline proposals (shadow-only) for 2 weeks; measure prediction error.
Phase 2 (internal canary): Enable Safe Apply in shadow + 1% canary for non-critical routes for 1 week.
Phase 3 (customer pilot): opt-in customers on Dedicated; run guided proposals via Console.
Phase 4: gradual opt-out/opt-in global apply with strict guardrails and nightly audits.
telemetry_metrics:
- proposal_count, accepted_proposals, average_estimated_cost_delta, realized_cost_delta, rollback_count, mean_latency_50/95/99 delta, error_rate_delta, kv_cache_hit_rate_estimate, apply_time_ms
- business metrics: monthly_cost_savings_estimate, adoption_rate
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: False positives causing latency regressions. Mitigation: conservative default heuristics, mandatory shadow runs, strict canary limits, and automatic rollback.
Risk: Overfitting ranker to historical patterns. Mitigation: regular validation, holdout test routes, and human-in-the-loop sign-off for high-impact routes.
Risk: Security/compliance for Private customers. Mitigation: run Oracle inference in customer VPC or provide offline packaging and audit logs only.
open_questions:
- What is the TTL for profiler snapshots vs. real-time streaming? Suggested 24h snapshots + 15m rolling histograms.
- Where do we store historical AB results for training ranker? Proposal: central metrics DB with limited retention.
- How should Console expose 'expected quality risk' to non-ML users? We should provide simple risk bands (Low/Medium/High) with examples.
tasks: Instrument per-route telemetry ingestion (histogram seq len, interarrival)
Implement fingerprint ingestion pipeline and rolling window store
Build heuristic rule set and simulation harness
Prototype small ML ranker to prioritize candidates
Safe Apply controller + control plane integration (feature flagging)
Console UI: proposal list + one-click apply/rollback
E2E tests and chaos scenarios (latency injection)
Run internal pilot and collect feedback
